propositions: An ADR must document three committed-format changes to .bridge_state (A2 last_get_pass relocation, A3 scalar baseline normalization, A4-2 prev_snapshot narrowing) plus one field deletion (A1 baseline_advanced_at deletion).

The mixed-version protocol reads chronological max(new, legacy) to support multi-version deployments, and requires direct evidence of successful host-probe refresh at a descendant build before stopping legacy writes, not elapsed time.

Rollback boundaries differ per change: A2-1 fully reversible, A3 reversible through idempotent canonicalization, A2-2 reverts only to A2-1-or-newer, A4-2 requires recorded forward and reverse corpus evidence.
Bridge state remains committed on-branch because ephemeral GitHub-hosted runners require durable state; epic 6c9c rejected off-branch relocation.
Measured cost reduction from format changes: 12.79 KB to 1.74 KB marginal post-A1, with 218/399 identical prev_snapshot key sets across the corpus (session log 1cb6-d553-6565-49b4).
Assignee field is excluded from normalization because _assignee_candidates requires its raw shape for correct candidacy resolution.
